reviews.developer_response:
I realize you are probably not actually looking for an answer to this question, but for anyone reading this and curious about why I'm making this game, here's the short-ish answer.

First off, I'm huge into VR and have been into it my whole life. I started off modding Quake 2 and made a MOD for it called VRHS (Virtual Reality High School). Several years later I was one of the first to get an Oculus DK1 and after that I taught myself how to program and develop in Unreal.

In addition to that I'm extremely passionate about co-op and team based games. I have a group of friends dating back to high school (the same one I made the Q2 MOD for), and still play online with them today. 

Over the years that group has grown, and as it started to get bigger, like 6 to 10 people on Discord wanting to play, the fewer number of games exist that could support everyone (playing co-op).

Then take how few people have high end VR headsets, and there's even fewer games that can be played, which is why adding Desktop cross-play was so important. 

So the desire to make this game started with the wanting to make a game me and my friends would love to play, but I also know that there are many other groups out there looking for something similar.

I have read countless posts on Reddit, among other places, of people asking for exactly what I am building and I want to deliver a quality product / experience to them.

Obviously it's going to take a lot of time and work, but if you compare the current version (v1.18) from even a year ago when the game was released in Early Access, there is a gigantic difference in all aspects of the game and I expect that progression to continue.

reviews.review:
EDIT: Since the big engine change update, the game is MUCH more polished. Shooting feels better and more realistic and performance issues have been fixed for me for the most part.


This is a GREAT VR game. It's very early and has some minor issues that absolutely need tweaking, but it's already really entertaining and immersive. 

PRO:

- IMMERSIVE AND EXCITING
- VEHICLES WITH HEADLIGHTS AND INTERACTIVE STICK SHIFT (DRIVING IS SEMI STRANGE THOUGH LOL)
- NICE AMOUNT OF LOOT TO FIND IN THE WORLD. THIS ISN'T DAY Z.
- LOTS OF GEAR TO FIND, INCLUDING CLOTHING TO WEAR
- MULTIPLAYER IS EXTREMELY IMMERSIVE AND FUN
- DIFFICULT, BUT NOT TARKOV DIFFICULT
- RUNS VERY SMOOTH ON MY 3060 TI + RYZEN 5 2600 X + 16 GB RAM BUILD
- A BRIGHT FUTURE BRIMMING WITH POTENTIAL

CONS:

- OPEN WORLD IS FINE, BUT LACKING DETAIL AND DIRECTION. NEED MORE MEMORABLE LANDMARKS AND MORE CONCISE, LOGICAL PATHS
- MORE ALIEN VARIETY (IT'S FINE THOUGH TBH)
- GUN FIRE IS SLIGHTLY CORNY, BUT IT'S ALSO WELL DONE. HARD TO EXPLAIN. KIND OF LOOKS LIKE YOU ARE SHOOTING BB GUN PELLETS, BUT IT STILL ENDS UP FEELING BRUTAL WHEN YOU GET A NICE KILL.
- DRIVING IS AWESOME, BUT WEIRD. YOU CAN ONLY HOLD THE WHEEL WITH ONE HAND AND THE OTHER ON THE STICK. YOU USE THE STICK AS A GAS PEDAL ESSENTIALLY, WHICH IS STRANGE AF.
- GRIP CONTROLS ARE EXTREMELY WONKY AND NEED A TON OF WORK. PREPARE TO BE FIDDLING AROUND LIKE A FOOL TRYING TO PULL YOUR KNIFE OUT ETC. THINGS JUST DON'T REGISTER AND BOTH TRIGGERS SEEM TO DO THE SAME THING, BUT AT AN INCONSISTENT RATE. THIS IS THE WORST ISSUE IN THE GAME IMO.

Even at full price, I would say this is worth your money in it's current state. There is no other VR game like this at the moment and I can see this blowing up in popularity soon. As for the desktop version? I have no idea, but this game was clearly made for VR first.

[h1]Experienced on the Meta Quest 2[/h1]

You can view my initial impressions review & gameplay here: https://youtu.be/QpfVfnOdqbI

I bought this during the Steam Survival Fest for only $1.39 USD. I think at that price, this game is a good deal. It definitely has its problems and there is a very good reason it is 90% off. However, you're also not likely to find better VR experiences at this low of a price. This is a dumb, silly, mindless arcade survival FPS. It was made by a 2 person dev team. It's in Early Access and needs lots of polish.

However, it can be fun, as long as you can look past the jank. I had fun. If you're expecting 7 Days To Die type quality survival experience, you're going to be greatly disappointed. But if you're happy with the budget, B-movie, arcadey version of 7 Days to Die, then you'll probably enjoy it.

Game is running on the Unreal Engine. On my RTX 3080, I was getting steady 90 fps. I did not experience any serious issues or bugs. However, the game was overall very clunky. The inventory system in particular can be frustrating to deal with. The enemy AI is very dumb. You do have full locomotion & smooth turning available. You can play seated or standing. There's lots of weapons & melee as well. It is best played with online coop with friends.

[b]90% Off Sale Price Rating 7/10. Normal Price Rating 5/10.[/b]

reviews.review: Not a bad game. Definitely fun to play. I've only played single player so far and enjoying it. Is a bit buggy but nothing unexpected. I can see this being an amazing game down the road. With some fixes and adjustments etc.
Only tried the desktop version so far, but the game has potential for sure, very active and friendly dev team, had issues launching the game but Xtian helped me out :)

Pro's: I paid $1.39
Con's: It needs a ton of work.  But it has promise.

Will change my review when the dev updates the game some more.  I bought it to help the dev.

A couple of tips to the dev.  

Pick one either go full VR or Desktop.  At least this early in your development, because that way you can make one of the iterations much better without affecting the quality of the other.

I dont know if the models you used are place holders.  If they are then you are good, if these are your final models, then ... <cringe> I would say invest in higher quality ones, or work with the textures.

The game feels clunky, at this stage at least.  I thought the hand was cool, a bit Addams Family, but dunno what relation it has to this game?

Anyways, work on the game some more and if its updated I'll revise my review, but at this stage I can't recommend it unless you are doing research for building your own game.

Cheers!

Started playing the game
Found food very difficult to find
Realized zombies were dropping food, usually raw meat
Found something that looked like a potato
Couldn't eat it. In hindsight, might have been a zombie turd.
Died trying to eat said turd.

8/10

Pretty much everything about this game is done in the worst, most terrible way POSSIBLE!

It looks AWFUL, only has 1 male, & 1 female character to chose from with NO options to change their looks... Sure you pick up clothing in the matches, but the LONGEST you could possibly keep any of it is 25 minutes, & "IF" there's a way to actually "survive" the level, & keep any of the hats, backpacks, shirts, pants, gloves, etc. I sure couldn't figure out how. Also if You try to make the game look nice, like turning up grass etc. it WILL run like crap, yes even on your' overpowered rig too!

The music is awful, the interiors look like a 4 year old playing the SIMs place the few objects in each building, the houses almost all look alike, the fences, & other building assets are usually overlapping in strage ways making everything look even fruitier.

The inventory system is wack, the good guns you may stumble upon have almost no ammunition, the mele is useless, the zombies don't even SEE you until you're right up on them, & even though they may have been wearing something cool, they only drop a gun, & maybe a grenade, or lighter, etc. The closest FOV is still to far out, I can see My vest... I dunno if there's anybody playing this in multiplayer, & I don't care, it's awful, & it's SO BAD of a game the way it is now, I sincerely doubt it will EVER be anything except an unfun, unfair, sloppy aiming (even aiming with the mouse from 20 feet away the bullet act as if they were shot from a musket with no rifeling, they go every which way, spraying, & missing the target MOST of the time, I mean with an uber mechgun I found in a military base, not the base model, if I had a machinegun [, or even a handgun], and couldn't gloop an enemy 20 feet away IRL, I'd turn to run away! ...)

So if You like cruddy looking games that would have been groundbreaking in 1995, except the spraying bullets, ridiculous inventory system, & everything else that's cringe at best about this game, dislike fun things, like your' ears, & eyes bleeding due to yuck, or you just wanna waste time playing something AWFUL, then this is the game for YOU! If You're normal in most ways, go play ANYTHING else! I paid $1.39 USD, & feel like I got ripped off.
